title: missing-companion-launch-failure
setup: Compile/package successfully in a test-owned output tree, then remove only Worker's generated companion executable before running the orchestrator. Record this as artifact fault injection; do not modify L source or protected fixtures.
assertions: No child process is created; no OS Wait is called for the failed launch.
Run creates a terminal failed attempt; Await resolves its startup cause instead of reporting never started.
Output of that failed attempt is available and empty after completion.
